_meta.description: P10.T2 eval set: draft facts extracted from a turn plus the existing memory entries they were matched against, labeled with the reviewer's decision. action semantics: add = no existing entry covers the draft; update = an existing entry covers the same topic and the draft revises or extends it (target names the entry, history keeps the old value); skip = the draft restates an existing entry with no new information; conflict = the draft contradicts an existing entry without an explicit correction signal, so it needs user review rather than a silent write.
